%%err t.sv:34:7: error[VITA-E2002] E-PARSE-UNEXPECTED-TOKEN: expected a net or variable — vita supports the streaming operator (pack/unpack, IEEE 1800-2017 §11.4.14) only as a right-hand-side EXPRESSION, not as an assignment target: write `{b0,b1,b2,b3} = {<<8{a}}` rather than `{>>{b0,b1,b2,b3}} = a`, found '<<'
%%use b0
%%use b2
  initial begin
    #1;
     {<<{a4, b8}} = 'x;
    #2;
    $display("C:a4=%b", a4);
    $display("C:b8=%b", b8);
    $finish;
  end
  initial #60 $finish;
endmodule

%%end

%%out a4	xxxx
%%out b8	xxxxxxxx
%%use b0
%%use b2
  initial begin
    #1;
     k = 0; for ({a4, b8} = 'x; k < 1; k = k + 1) ;
    #2;
    $display("C:a4=%b", a4);
    $display("C:b8=%b", b8);
    $finish;
  end
  initial #60 $finish;
endmodule

%%end
%%cell S8_hier_whole_x
%%meta g2	S8	hier_whole	'x	right	-
%%out ub8	xxxxxxxx
%%use b0
%%use b3
%%use b5

    #1;
     k = 0; for (u.b8 = 'x; k < 1; k = k + 1) ;
    #2;
    $display("C:ub8=%b", u.b8);
    $finish;
  end
  initial #60 $finish;
endmodule

%%end
%%cell S8_late_partsel_bits_x

%%err t.sv:51:18: error[VITA-E3009] E-ELAB-UNSUPPORTED: the width of this assignment target (8 bits) is known only after elaboration (a bound reads a name resolved then), but an `'x` or `'z` fill was sized before that, as 32 bit(s) [in t]

%%use b5

%%cell P7h_take_callfill
%%meta plan	PLAN	P7h_take_callfill	-	loud	-
%%err t.sv:35:15: error[VITA-E3009] E-ELAB-UNSUPPORTED: function `f` has an output/inout formal, so its copy-out has to be emitted as a statement before the expression that calls it. That works in any position evaluated ONCE per statement, but not here. The remaining cases are: a CONTINUOUSLY re-evaluated expression (`assign`, `force`, a `wait` condition) — the copy-out cannot re-fire on every change; an intra-assignment delay (`x = #1 f(...)`); a `min:typ:max` or a constraint/`with` expression; any position inside a FUNCTION body lowered as a call frame (a function is entered from the expression that calls it, so it has no call statement of its own to carry the copy-out) — the same call in a TASK body, or in a module process, does work; and an evaluation-order case the hoist cannot preserve — an output actual read to the LEFT of the call when the actual is not a plain bit-vector net, when two calls in the same expression write it, or when a call the hoist leaves in place could read it (its body, or an OMITTED formal's default, or a method on a non-container receiver). Assign the call to a temporary first (`t = f(...);`) and use `t`. [in t]

%%use b111
%%use b112
  initial begin
    #1;
    c = 1'b0; x8 = c ? 8'h00 : (f(o8) | '1);
    #2;
    $display("C:x8=%b", x8);
    $display("C:o8=%b", o8);
    $finish;
  end
  initial #60 $finish;
endmodule

%%err t.sv:5:5: error[VITA-E3009] E-ELAB-UNSUPPORTED: $bits argument shape unsupported (nets, array views, and self-determined expressions fold; v7) [in top.u]

%%err errors=4 warnings=1 notes=0
module c #(parameter logic [3:0] W = 2) ();
  typedef struct packed { logic [W-1:0] a; logic [2:0] b; } s_t; s_t s_t__v;
  s_t v; logic [W-1:0] n;
  initial begin #1 v = '0; v.a = '1; v.b = 3'b101; n = '1;
    $display("A bs=%0d ba=%0d bn=%0d", $bits(s_t__v), $bits(v.a), $bits(n));

typedef struct packed { logic [63:0] PAD; logic [7:0] HI; } prm_t;      // 72-bit packed-struct parameter type
module top #(parameter prm_t pt = 72'h0000000000000000_05);              // HI = 5
  logic [31:1]       f;
  logic [31:pt.HI+1] a;                                                   // [31:6]

  assign a[31:pt.HI+1] = sel ? f[31:pt.HI+1] : '0;                      // CA: part-selects bounded by a wide-parameter member
